validation_queries.description: No GPU device metrics are recorded with amd-smi excluded
validation_queries.error_message: OVER-COLLECTION: GPU PMC events present though amd-smi was excluded
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.target_arch = 'GPU'
